meta.title: Dispute Task Assignment to Stakeholders: refused for a user without the AP Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the AP Manager role and attempt Dispute Task Assignment to Stakeholders for a dispute.
Sign in as an AP Manager on the same tenant and verify the assignment action is available and succeeds.
Observe or record tenant RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the AP Manager role and attempt Dispute Task Assignment to Stakeholders for a dispute.; Sign in as an AP Manager on the same tenant and verify the assignment action is available and succeeds.; Observe or record tenant RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as a non-AP-Manager user and an AP Manager on the same Growth tenant, attempt Dispute Task Assignment to Stakeholders for buyer, vendor, warehouse, and finance stakeholders, and record whether the action is refused or available for each role

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the dispute workflow or switch between user roles, so tester intervention is required for the complete RBAC comparison.
Assert that the session remains free of application errors after the tester completes or skips the unavailable role-based workflow.
